name: save-boot-9-highway
description: #80, minigame: boot from the generated save harness/saves/disc1-highway.json: module state 6 (GAMESTATE_HIGHWAY, the motorcycle minigame, in the decomp's include/game.h), location md1stin (where the game would go afterwards), party Cloud, Barret, Tifa, progress 6. In the decomp (reference only) the title's load copies the state into g_GameState, and the main loop then loads and runs the highway overlay; story mode, since bank 2 byte 0x73 is 0 at New Game. Load as save-boot-1-load does, but wait for g_GameState 6 (w_state). Then 300 frames for the overlay to load, a mark, 300 frames more. Checks: g_GameState still reads 6 (mini_ok), the highway's track position has increased since the mark (live: the race runs), and a rerun from the title snapshot ends in the same state (match). Reported: prev_state, exit (g_HighwayExit, 0 while racing).

game_state.description: g_GameState (s16 as u16; field 1, battle 2, menu 5 confirmed #76).

track_pos.description: g_HighwayTrackPos (highway overlay, s32 as u32): how far along the track the race is. Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@9411173 (reference only, no code) config/symbols.highway.us.txt, src/mini/highway/highway.c.

exit.description: g_HighwayExit (highway overlay): non-zero ends the race loop. Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@9411173 (reference only, no code) config/symbols.highway.us.txt.
